title: Workshop Pilot Status
subtitle: Operations review
purpose: Give the program manager enough evidence to decide whether the training pilot can expand.

criteria: A concise one-page review with editable metrics and an actionable decision.

blocks.text: Two pilot workshops reached the attendance target. Survey participation fell short, so the team needs one more cohort before using satisfaction scores to guide expansion.
Offer the survey in the final five minutes of the next workshop. Compare the response rate with this pilot before drawing conclusions about participant satisfaction.

blocks.title: Decision requested
blocks.text: Approve one more cohort at the current capacity and review the expansion decision when the next survey closes.
